content: Pathian deina tungtawn in Jesus Christ i sawltak a hi tu in a kisam keima Paul le ka suapui pa Sosthenes in,
Christ Jesus in thiangthosak a, mithiangtho te ci a ki sam, Corinth a om Pathian pawlpi le mun tatuam a i Topa Jesus Christ min a sam theampo tung ah:
I Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ kung pan in hesuakna le thinnopna sia note tungah hong om tahen.
Pathian Tungah Lungdamna
Jesus Christ tungtawn in note tungah hongpiak Pathian i thuthiamna atu in, note tang in ka Pathian ka pok hi;
Tabang in na kampauna theampo uh le na heakna uh theampo, na theampo ah Ama in hong hausak zo hi;
Christ i tettipanna zong note sungah hong kipsak zo hi:
Tabang in i Topa Jesus Christ hongpai tu na ngak uh kawm in letsong khat zong na kisam bua uh hi:
Tabang in i Topa Jesus Christ ni ciang paubang ngawl na hi thei natu uh in, Ama in a tawp dong hong kipsak tu hi.
A Tapa i Topa Jesus Christ taw ki pawlkhopna nei tu in note hongsam Pathian sia a thuman Pathian a hihi.
Pawlpi Sung Kikhenna

Tu in suapui te awng, na vekpi in na kampauna uh kibang tek in, ki khenna om ngawl, a picing thu kisikna taw ki pawlkhawm tu le thukhenna kibang tek hi tu in, i Topa Jesus Christ min taw kong thum hi.
Banghangziam cile ka suapui te awng, note sungah kihauna om hi, ci in Chloe te innkuan tung pan in kei tungah note i thu hong ki pualak zo hi.

Tu in hi thu kong son hi, noma sungah khatsim in, keima sia Paul i pawl khi hi; taciang kei sia Apollos i pawl ka hihi; taciang kei sia Peter i pawl ka hihi; taciang kei sia Christ i pawl ka hihi, na ci uh hi.
Christ sia ki khen ziam? Paul sia note atu in thinglamte tungah a ki khai ziam? a hibale, Paul min taw tui na ki phum uh ziam?
Note sungah Crispus le Gaius simngawl kuama tuiphum ngawl ka hikom in Pathian tung ka lungdam hi;
Tua ahikom, Paul in ama min taw tuiphumna pia hi, kuama in ci thei ngawl tu hi.
Taciang Stephen te innkuan zong keima in tui ka phum hi: tua te simngawl a dang tui ka phum ka he bua hi.

Banghangziam cile Christ in tuiphumna pia tu in hong sawl ngawl a, lungdamna thupha hil tu in hong sawl hi: tua thu sia ciimna kammal te taw hil tu hi ngawl hi, tabang hile Christ thinglamte sia vang nei ngawl suak tu hi.
Christ sia Pathian Vangletna le Ciimna
Banghangziam cile thinglamte thuhilna sia a mangthang te atu in mawmawtna a hihi; ahihang ngupna a sang te a tu in Pathian i vangletna a hihi.
Banghangziam cile, a ciim te i ciimna ka susia tu a, mipil te i telthiamna zong a mannung ngawl ka suaksak tu hi, ci in ki at hi.
Mihing ciim koisung ah om ziam? Thukhamhil te koisung ah om ziam? hi leitung ah thu nial te e koisung ah om ziam? Pathian in hi leitung pilna sia mawmawtna suaksak zo hi ngawl ziam?
Banghangziam cile leitung mite in pilna taw Pathian a heak ngawl zawk uh ciang, Pathian i pilna sungah mawmawtna thu pualakna a umte ngum tu in Pathian a lungkim hi.
Banghangziam cile Judah mite in musakna ngen uh hi, taciang Greek mite in pilna zong uh hi:
Ahihang kote in thinglamte tungah a ki khai Christ thu ka hil uh hi, tua thu sia Judah mite atu in lutuna a hihi, taciang Greek mite atu in mawmawtna a hihi;
Ahihanng a kisam Judah mite le Greek mite atu in Christ sia Pathian vangletna le pilna a hihi.
Banghangziam cile Pathian i mawmawtna sia mihing te pilna sang in ciim zaw hi; taciang Pathian i thaneamna sia mihing te hatna sang in hat zaw hi.
Topa Sungah Ki Suangtak
Banghangziam cile suapui te awng, nang hong kisapna thu en vun, cilesa lam pan in mipil tampi, a vanglian le ulian thupi tampi na om bua uh hi:
Ahihang Pathian in mipil te maizumsak tu in leitung taw kisai in a mawmaw te teal hi; taciang Pathian in a thahat te maizumsak tu leitung taw kisai in a thaneam te teal hi;
A omsa nate a mannung ngawl a suaksak tu in, leitung na mannung ngawl, bangma a ki simngawl nate le a om ngawl lai nate dong in Pathian in teal hi:
Tabang in Pathian mai ah kuama ki suangtak ngawl tu hi.
Ahihang note Ama tungtawn in Christ Jesus sungah na om uh hi, Ama sia Pathian in eite atu in pilna, thutang suana, thianthosakna le tatna in hong vawtsak hi:
Tabang in, a ki at sa bangma in, a ki suangtak te Topa sungah ki suangtak tahen.
